qualifier: UNC93B1 trafficking and TLR3-pathway herpes encephalitis deficiencies
name: Endosomal TLR signaling, trafficking and herpes encephalitis deficiencies
rationale: All members concern endosomal TLR3/7/8/9 signaling or its regulation, and unlike the confusables the theme carries endosomal TLR trafficking (UNC93B1) and the TLR3/TICAM1/TRAF3 HSE deficiencies.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR mutants and TKI resistance
rationale: Members are cancer-associated RTK mutants, fusions and their TKI binding or resistance, centred on KIT, PDGFR, ALK and FGFR rather than the ERBB2, FLT3 or cytokine-receptor signaling of the confusables.

qualifier: chondrocyte differentiation, cartilage and joint formation
name: Chondrocyte differentiation in skeletal and joint development
rationale: Members cover cartilage, chondrocyte, joint, ossification and RUNX2-driven skeletal development, whereas the confusables focus on osteoblast proliferation and differentiation and Wnt signaling.

name: Double-strand break end resection and single-strand annealing
rationale: All members concern resection of DSB ends and the SSA repair route it feeds, distinct from the BRCA/PALB2 homologous recombination and NHEJ confusables.

name: Lipid droplet breakdown by lipophagy
rationale: All members describe autophagic disassembly of lipid droplets, whereas confusables cover droplet formation, fusion and lipogenesis.

qualifier: cationic amino acids and proton-coupled oligopeptides
name: Cationic and neutral amino acid and oligopeptide transport
rationale: Members are transport of neutral and cationic amino acids and di/oligopeptides, distinguished by proton/oligopeptide cotransport and arginine/SLC7A7 cationic transport absent from the confusables.

qualifier: prostanoids, leukotrienes, endocannabinoids and inflammatory GPCRs
name: Prostanoid, leukotriene and endocannabinoid mediators with inflammatory GPCRs
rationale: Members cover arachidonate release, COX and leukotriene synthesis and signaling plus endocannabinoid and histamine/P2Y/FFA receptors, which the lipoxin, HETE and resolvin confusables lack.

name: Error-prone translesion DNA synthesis
rationale: All three members are error-prone lesion bypass by POLK or REV1, distinct from the error-free POLH translesion, replication and excision-repair confusables.

name: Activated B lymphocyte signatures in lymphoid tissue
rationale: Members are B-cell-enriched transcription modules and an activated lymphoid surface-marker module, distinct from confusables on naive/memory B cells, T cell differentiation and germinal centre GO terms.

name: Maternal mRNA clearance in the maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members cover M- and Z-decay of maternal mRNAs, deadenylation, cleavage and egg cytoplasm/protein storage, unlike the chromatin/ZGA and general mRNA-decay confusables.

name: Depolarisation-induced mitophagy and mitochondrial fission-fusion control
rationale: Members concern PINK1-PRKN and receptor mitophagy, mitochondrial depolarisation, fission/fusion and protein localization to mitochondria, unlike pexophagy, reticulophagy or mitochondrial import confusables.

core: Cell-surface TLR sensing of bacterial ligands
name: MyD88-dependent cell-surface TLR sensing of bacterial ligands
rationale: Members cover LPS, lipopeptide and lipoteichoic acid detection by TLR2/4/5 and MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies, distinct from inflammasome and NOD1/2 confusables.

core: Viral attachment and entry into host cells
name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment, entry and cell-cell fusion
rationale: Members describe virion receptor binding, endocytic entry and fusion for RSV, Dengue and other viruses, unlike the influenza entry and viral protein maturation confusables.

qualifier: IKK complex recruitment by IRAK1 and RIP1
name: IKK complex recruitment and canonical NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members concern IRAK1/RIP1-mediated IKK recruitment and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB, distinct from TAK1 activation, IRF3/7 and TNFR1 confusables.

qualifier: PLC-gamma and GRB7 branch driving motility
name: PLC-gamma and GRB7 branch of ERBB2 motility signaling
rationale: Members are ERBB2/EGFR effector events via PLC-gamma and GRB7 leading to cell motility, whereas confusables cover the GRB2, SHC1 and PI3K branches.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members cover keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis, cornification and skin barrier, distinguished from sebaceous, melanocyte and cornified-envelope-only confusables by keratinocyte regulation.

qualifier: TRIF- and IRAK-dependent activation of TAK1, IKK and IRF3/7
name: TRIF- and IRAK-dependent TLR activation of TAK1, IKK and IRFs
rationale: Members are TRIF/TICAM1 and IRAK/TRAF6 steps activating TAK1, IKK, TBK1-IRF3/7 and TRIF cell death, which confusables lack in favor of NF-kappaB regulation or endosomal TLR trafficking.

name: Insulin-stimulated glucose uptake, glycogen synthesis and glucokinase regulation
rationale: Members cover insulin-driven glucose import, glycogen synthesis, insulin receptor handling and glucokinase regulation, the last distinguishing it from insulin signaling and secretion confusables.

name: Microglia differentiation, activation and glial proliferation control
rationale: Members concern microglial/glial differentiation, activation, proliferation, migration and survival, without the amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance content of the confusables.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar and PAPS transport and their disorders
name: Nucleotide-sugar and PAPS donor supply for Golgi glycosylation
rationale: Members are synthesis and SLC35/SLC26A2/SLC33A1 transport of nucleotide sugars, PAPS and related donors and their genetic defects, whereas confusables cover the glycosylation and GAG synthesis reactions themselves.

name: Glycogen metabolism, glucose-6-phosphate handling and storage diseases
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, breakdown and storage diseases plus glucose-6-phosphate routing through glycolysis and gluconeogenesis, distinct from fructose and glucagon confusables.

qualifier: methylation and nuclear exosome RNA surveillance
name: Pre-rRNA processing, methylation and nuclear exosome RNA surveillance
rationale: Members cover pre-rRNA cleavage, snoRNP-guided methylation and exosome-mediated nuclear RNA decay, unlike the transcription/splicing, tRNA processing and pseudouridylation confusables.

qualifier: S-adenosylmethionine use for choline, creatine and carnitine
name: S-adenosylmethionine methyl metabolism of choline, creatine and carnitine
rationale: Members cover SAM synthesis/hydrolysis defects and methyl-consuming choline, creatine and carnitine pathways, distinct from methionine salvage, acyl-CoA and choline transport confusables.

name: Dendritic cell and macrophage chemokine production and recruitment
rationale: Members regulate CCL/CXCL chemokine and DC cytokine production and macrophage chemotaxis, unlike the Th1/IFN-gamma, inflammasome and neutrophil confusables.

name: Cardiac contractility enhancement and cardiomyocyte hypertrophic adaptation
rationale: Members positively regulate heart contraction force and rate plus cardiac adaptation and sarcomere growth, which the calcium-handling and negative-regulation confusables lack.
